title: Assignments – Overview
content:
[32555 Fundamentals of Software Development | Assignments – Overview]
Assignments in 32555 Fundamentals of Software Development. The subject has three main assessment tasks.

Task 1: Case Study — 70% (consists of Part 1: Analysis and Design – 15 points, Part 2: Software Development – 50 points, and Part 3: Project Showcase – 5 points)
Task 2: Quiz 1 — 15% (multiple-choice quiz)
Task 3: Quiz 2 — 15% (includes Java and Python components)

title: Module – Week 1: Requirements Analysis
content:
[32555 Fundamentals of Software Development | Module – Week 1: Requirements Analysis]
Lecture 1: Requirements Analysis
This week introduces the software development process and requirements analysis.

Topics:
- Introduction to software development
- Software development life cycle
- Software development methodologies
- Programming paradigms
- Requirements analysis and validation
- UML introduction
- Use-case diagrams

Lab 1: Requirements Analysis
In the lab, students practise:
- identifying user requirements from a case study
- distinguishing functional and non-functional requirements
- documenting system requirements
- creating simple use-case models

title: Module – Week 2: Software Design
content:
[32555 Fundamentals of Software Development | Module – Week 2: Software Design]
Lecture 2: Object-Oriented Design
This week introduces object-oriented software design.

Topics:
- Objects and classes
- Object-oriented design principles
- Class diagrams
- Relationships between classes
- Translating requirements into a software design

Lab 2: Object-Oriented Design
Students practise:
- identifying candidate classes
- creating class diagrams
- defining relationships between classes
- developing an initial software design from requirements
